training_reward.definition: sum(episode mean reward_total * episode steps) / sum(episode steps)

category_specific_terms.scissors: coarse+fine tracking; palm-only grasp; interaction .25; no contact auxiliary
category_specific_terms.push: tracking 2; thumb contact .25; two-finger grasp and drop/tip failure
category_specific_terms.spray: tracking 2; index proximity .25; two-finger grasp and drop/tip failure

training_protocol.caveat: Equal simulator steps do not imply equal simulated seconds across categories.

zero.pca_rule: fit PCA on unique initial postures of four known tools only
